label: SYNTHETIC EXECUTION — engineering check of the study bootstrap; not the A v0.6 evaluation
note: the interval represents uncertainty conditional on the observed history; it is reported separately from the observed balance and is not a verdict (design §6-§7)
percentile_convention: Hyndman-Fan type 7 (linear between order statistics, h = (B - 1) p), p = 0.025 / 0.975
procedure: one random.Random(seed); for resample b = 0..B-1, for block j = 0..k-1: s = randrange(N - L + 1); block j covers grid hours s .. s + length_j - 1; lengths L except the last, truncated to N - L(k-1); no wrap; statistic = exact sum of the resampled hourly values
reading: no automatic verdict of effectiveness or promotion (design §7)
